verdict.rationale: Riveter supports scale-oriented features like batch enrichment of up to 10,000 rows per request, async runs with webhooks, scheduling/monitoring, and SDK-level retry/pagination handling, which implicitly support running many jobs at scale. However, there is no explicit documentation of concurrency limits, parallel session management, or throughput guarantees for running many scraping sessions simultaneously. Missing for 10: explicit concurrency/rate-limit documentation, evidence of parallel session orchestration, and independent benchmarks of concurrent scrape throughput.
